title: Level 2 Classical Studies — Significance of Art Works 2025
subject: classical-studies

questions.text:
Answer ONE of the following questions with reference to one or more classical art works or buildings. You must answer using paragraphs. Support your answer with evidence from one or more classical art works or buildings. Aim for a concise answer of no more than 4-5 pages.

Question 1: How did the stylistic features of a classical art work help communicate a message(s)?

Question 2: Explain how the design and/or decoration of a classical building served society's needs.

Question 3: How did an artist communicate classical ideals through the depiction of the human body?

Question 4: In what ways was a later culture influenced by a classical art work?
questions.markingGuide: Achievement (3-4 marks): Examine the significance of features of work(s) of art in the classical world. Explain the features and effect of the work(s) of art, use primary-source evidence, place the work(s) in their artistic and/or historical context, and draw conclusions. Knowledge and interpretation are at a basic level; specific evidence may be lacking. Merit (5-6 marks): Examine in-depth by giving an informed explanation of the features and effects of work(s) of art, drawing conclusions supported by primary-source evidence of specific relevance to the context, and explaining a range of aspects/factors. Most parts include some detail. Excellence (7-8 marks): Examine with perception by giving an explanation that shows insight into the features and effects of work(s) of art. Draw developed conclusions, e.g. how the aesthetic features of a classical work of art reflect the ideals of beauty held by the Greeks and/or Romans. Features may include aesthetic impact, reasons for similarities and differences, themes and patterns, and cultural expectations. All parts include detail with relevant, accurate, and consistently provided evidence.
